correctness.rationale: For n>=3 the self-loop relation is symmetric and NOR is its Galois polarity, so F^3=F; a single marked-vertex state has exact entrance time one. Fixed states correspond to maximal independent sets avoiding vertex zero and hence Perrin(n)-pathMIS(n-3). A 16-state transfer pair bijection gives Q_n=tr(D A^(n-1)); exact integer multiplication verifies A q(A)=0 and the first ten trace coefficients, establishing the rational generating function for all n. Unmarked R_n is Perrin(2n) (odd n) or Perrin(n)^2 (even n) from the doubled-cycle cover. The dominant pole proves the asymptotic constant. Complete exhaustive enumeration n=3..12 independently corroborates the finite identity; no infinite theorem is inferred solely from samples.
